nodes.description: Constant bytes32 namehash of addr.reverse, used to look up the ENS reverse registrar node owner.
Public string storing the managed ENS root name (e.g. mirror.xyz), set once in the constructor.
Immutable bytes32 node of the managed root name, used for all subnode registrations and root ownership changes.
Immutable reference to the canonical ENS registry (IENS) used for setSubnodeRecord, setOwner and owner lookups.
Immutable address of the MirrorWriteToken that is the only allowed caller of register().
Immutable reference to the IENSResolver used to write forward/reverse address and name records.
Mutable cached IENSReverseRegistrar address, set by updateENSReverseRegistrar().
Private owner address inherited from Ownable, gates onlyOwner functionality.
External onlyWriteToken entry point that assigns a forward and reverse ENS subdomain to owner_.
External onlyOwner function transferring root node ownership in the ENS registry.
External onlyOwner function refreshing the cached reverse registrar from the ENS registry.
Initializes rootName, rootNode, writeToken and the immutable ENS registry/resolver references.
Modifier requiring msg.sender to equal the immutable writeToken address.
Modifier requiring _owner to equal _msgSender().
OnlyOwner function transferring ownership to a non-zero newOwner.
OnlyOwner function setting _owner to the zero address.
Public view getter returning the current Ownable owner address.
Caller-supplied address used by the onlyWriteToken and onlyOwner access-control checks.
External call to the ENS registry creating the subnode record for the new label.
External call to the ENS resolver writing the forward address record for the node.
External call to the ENS resolver writing the reverse name record for the owner.
External call to the ENS registry transferring ownership of the root node.
External view call to the cached reverse registrar computing the reverse node of owner_.
External view call to the ENS registry reading the owner of a node (duplicate-registration check and reverse registrar lookup).
Constructor parameter supplying the initial ENS root name.
Constructor parameter supplying the namehash of the root name.
Constructor parameter supplying the ENS registry address.
Constructor parameter supplying the ENS resolver address.
Constructor parameter supplying the authorized MirrorWriteToken address.
Subdomain label supplied by the caller of register().
Target owner address supplied by the caller of register().
New root node owner address supplied to changeRootNodeOwner().
New contract owner address supplied to transferOwnership().
keccak256 hash of label_ used as the ENS label node.
Derived subnode hash of rootNode and labelNode.
Concatenated full ENS name (label_ + '.' + rootName) written to the reverse resolver.
Reverse node hash returned by reverseRegistrar.node(owner_).
Local address cached from _msgSender() in the Ownable constructor.
Context helper returning msg.sender, used for access-control comparisons.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against writeToken inside the onlyWriteToken modifier to gate register().
msg.sender (via _msgSender) is compared against _owner inside the onlyOwner modifier to gate privileged functions.
msg.sender is returned by the Context._msgSender helper.
The immutable writeToken address is the fixed comparison target in onlyWriteToken.
The _owner state variable is the comparison target in onlyOwner.
onlyWriteToken guards entry into register().
onlyOwner guards entry into changeRootNodeOwner().
onlyOwner guards entry into updateENSReverseRegistrar().
onlyOwner guards entry into transferOwnership().
onlyOwner guards entry into renounceOwnership().
Constructor parameter rootName_ is assigned to the rootName state variable.
Constructor parameter rootNode_ is assigned to the immutable rootNode.
Constructor parameter writeToken_ is assigned to the immutable writeToken.
Constructor parameter ensRegistry_ is cast and assigned to the immutable ensRegistry reference.
Constructor parameter ensResolver_ is cast and assigned to the immutable ensResolver reference.
The constructor writes the rootName state variable.
The constructor writes the immutable rootNode value.
The constructor writes the immutable writeToken address.
_msgSender() result is stored in the local msgSender variable.
The local msgSender becomes the initial _owner value.
_msgSender() returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
The label_ parameter is hashed into labelNode.
register() computes the labelNode local from label_.
labelNode is combined with rootNode to produce the subnode hash.
The immutable rootNode feeds the subnode hash computation.
The computed node is passed to ensRegistry.owner() for the duplicate check.
register() invokes the external ENS registry setSubnodeRecord call.
rootNode is passed as the parent node to setSubnodeRecord.
labelNode is passed as the label to setSubnodeRecord.
owner_ is passed as the new subnode owner to setSubnodeRecord.
register() invokes the external resolver setAddr call.
The computed node is passed to resolver.setAddr.
owner_ is written as the forward address record.
label_ is concatenated into the name local variable.
rootName is concatenated into the name local variable.
owner_ is passed to reverseRegistrar.node() to compute the reverse node.
The reverse registrar result is stored in reverseNode.
The full name is written via resolver.setName.
The reverse node is passed as the target node to resolver.setName.
register() invokes the external resolver setName call.
The cached reverseRegistrar state variable is the target of the node() lookup.
changeRootNodeOwner() invokes the external ENS registry setOwner call.
rootNode is passed as the node whose owner changes.
_newOwner is passed as the new root node owner.
updateENSReverseRegistrar() queries ensRegistry.owner() for the addr.reverse node.
The ADDR_REVERSE_NODE constant is the lookup key for the reverse registrar owner.
The ENS registry result is stored into the mutable reverseRegistrar state variable.
newOwner is assigned to the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership() writes the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership() writes _owner to the zero address.
The root name string is embedded in the name written to the reverse resolver.
External call into the ENS registry returns control to register() before subsequent resolver calls complete.
External call into the dependency-injected resolver returns control to register() while registration state is still being written.
External call into the resolver for the reverse name returns control to register().
